newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian navy rescue anglers adrift on Baltic ice.
newsitem.headline: Russian navy rescue anglers adrift on Baltic ice.

text.p: Russian sailors rescued 13 anglers who went adrift in the Gulf of Finland after the ice from which they were fishing broke away on Tuesday night, an Emergencies Ministry spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
She said the search in the Gulf, an offshoot of the Baltic Sea west of the port city of St. Petersburg, would continue because earlier reports had said 14 people were on the ice.
"We are checking with people living in the neighbourhood the exact number of people who were there, but for the moment there are no signs of any more fishermen," she said.
The anglers were rescued from two separate floes -- nine early on Wednesday and another four later in the day.
